# Launch

CLI that builds an app and talks to App Store Connect and Google Play.

Commands: launch init, launch credentials, launch build ios, launch build android, launch release ios, launch release android, launch plan, launch sync, launch adopt.

Apple is a fetch client. Google Play uses @googleapis/androidpublisher. Secrets stay in the OS keychain.

plan prints the name and version diff. sync writes it. adopt copies the live store back into launch.config.ts. release sends an already uploaded build to review.
